I really don't understand this. First of all, this game has been carefully crafted. The developer loves Touhou and wants to bring more exciting gameplay to this IP. Even though AI was used, it's not some cheaply slapped-together, low-quality cash grab; he has put a lot of hard work into it. Nitpicking about the AI is completely meaningless.

Not every game has a well-known team or publisher behind it, and not every game has sufficient funding. The developer is a solo creator who managed to complete all of this entirely on his own, which is already quite admirable. Moreover, his financial situation is poor, and he can't afford to hire an art team. Using AI was not a wrong decision. We should encourage and support him. And if the game sells well later on, he will definitely change this situation. Touhou should be an inclusive IP, shouldn't it?

Yes, times are progressing, and AI has given many outstanding individual creators opportunities. Thanks to the development of AI, we are able to see creators one after another realizing their dreams. Many people probably haven't even seriously played this game; they take a few glances at it, label it as 'AI garbage,' and start trashing it loudly. This is disrespectful and highly irresponsible behavior toward the developer.

I've talked with the author. He poured his heart and soul into this game and tried his best to make it as good as possible. Doing this well on a first release is already great. There always needs to be someone to speak up for fairness. Objective reviews and reasonable suggestions are completely fine, but indiscriminate criticism is truly detestable.

Furthermore, the original creator of Touhou, ZUN strongly supports derivative works and encourages creators to realize their own vision of Gensokyo. This is exactly the meaning behind why the Touhou IP has been able to endure and continue to this day.

ZUN himself used AI art in one of the mainline Touhou games, for the backgrounds, IIRC, and while I am raising an eyebrow on it and find it very questionable, since ZUN can draw himself very well, it was his decision. Without him and his approval we would not even have fangames like this.
